summary: Phase 1A DOCX import — end-to-end validation of the Paloma renewal DOCX. Backend pytest suite 47/47 GREEN (as promised by main agent). Added 7 new e2e API tests in test_iter45_docx_e2e.py — all pass (upload-async accepts .docx, source_kind='docx', source_docx metadata, reference_pdf storage, source-docx download endpoint 200/401/404, verbatim score >=0.99). Frontend upload flow works end-to-end: modal accepts .docx + reveals optional reference PDF picker, progress bar animates through 6 stages, auto-navigates to editor in ~7s. Editor renders the Creative Mojo logo, cover-page centered titles, 5 tables (102 cells), 4 images, verbatim 100%. Table toolbar appears on cell click. rca of the issue:
DOCX-imported images are emitted by contract_docx_pipeline.convert_docx as raw at the block level (as siblings of

and , NOT nested inside a

When Tiptap parses this HTML on editor init, the images DO render in the ProseMirror DOM tree, but a mouse click on them does not translate to a NodeSelection on an image node — so `editor.isActive('image')` never becomes true and the [data-testid='image-toolbar'] conditional block is never rendered. Proof: inserting a fresh image via the toolbar (`editor.chain().focus().setImage({src: url}).run()`) DOES cause `editor.isActive('image')` to return true after a single click (verified in the last Playwright run — the sky-blue Image toolbar appeared as expected with all resize + align buttons). The fix should live in the DOCX pipeline post-processor: ensure every standalone is wrapped in a

before persistence. This also aligns with the DOCX cover-page requirement of centre-aligned artwork.
